knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Policy Controller在多個匹配政策間採共同滿足，同一政策內可有替代權威；本課以真值表驗證AND/OR層次，避免把兩個簽章需求誤寫成二擇一。
knowledge.textEn: Policy Controller combines matching policies and alternative authorities at different logical levels. Verify the AND/OR structure with a truth table, preventing two independently required approvals from accidentally becoming interchangeable alternatives within one policy.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立16個映像描述與兩個皆匹配的ClusterImagePolicy，每個政策列權威結果；固定namespace在執行範圍內，未匹配政策採本地deny。
knowledge.textEn: Build 16 image descriptors and two matching ClusterImagePolicy objects, recording authority outcomes inside each. Keep the namespace within enforcement scope and explicitly select deny for unmatched images so scope exclusions do not masquerade as policy success.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本課每個匹配政策至少一個authority通過，且所有匹配政策都通過才准入；總通過數必須由逐映像交集取得。沒有policy匹配的情況另依no-match-policy處理。
knowledge.textEn: At least one authority must pass inside each matching policy, and all matching policies must pass for admission. Derive counts from image-level intersections; the no-policy-match case is governed separately by no-match-policy, not by a vacuous mathematical AND.
